prompts.light: Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand. Input reference is the approved Marker B / DUET logo presentation. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY its large app icon as a production-ready square PNG with genuine alpha transparency outside the rounded-square tile. Preserve the EXACT B emblem silhouette: two offset upright document panels, left rising leftward, right rising rightward, with the identical central M-shaped negative space, soft geometric rounded corners and same proportions. Keep the same front-on geometry, never turn it into a new monogram. Remove ALL text, labels, tiny secondary symbols, and presentation background. One icon only centered symmetrically on a square canvas; tile occupies 82% canvas width and height, providing 9% transparent safety margin each side; minimal diffuse shadow within that margin. No full-bleed rectangular background. LIGHT edition: warm porcelain-white tile, midnight navy left panel and muted teal right panel exactly as reference, subtle matte material and shallow edge. No watermark, no text, no typography. Clean crisp edges readable at small icon sizes.
